text:
mika: heads-up — customer (tenant acme-markets) opened a ticket: rerank endpoint started returning weird output after last night's deploy. they see a 200 but all scores are 0.0

alex: do they call /v1/rerank or /v2/reRank?

mika: /v1/rerank. payload looks normal. example snippet they sent:

```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "ranker-v1", 
  "queries": ["best marketing subject"],
  "candidates": [["subject a", "subject b"]]
}
```

mika: response:
```
200 OK
{ "scores": [[0.0, 0.0]], "model": "ranker-v1" }
```

lenore: ticket includes an SDK stacktrace -> shows a 404 for model lookup just before returning zeros. looks like model alias resolution failed but we still returned the empty scores array. request-id: r-0a3b9c1d

support-bot: Automatcher flagged: model alias "ranker-v1" last updated 2025-11-08 (alias -> redwood/rerank-legacy).

alex: I think the alias was shadowed during the alias-migration job. If lookup fails we should return 4xx not 200 with zeros. this is a service bug.

eng-oncall: assigning to eng-inference. @alex can you drop repro steps and attach the full request/response and the request-id?

alex: repro steps I ran locally:
1) curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
2) payload.json uses "ranker-v1" alias
3) observed identical zeros when the alias resolver returned a 404 during migration

alex: local logs 
```
[2026-03-05T02:12:03Z] alias-resolver: lookup(ranker-v1) -> NOT_FOUND (deprecation: alias shadowed by ranker-2026)
[2026-03-05T02:12:03Z] rerank-service: fallback -> default-ranker (score pipeline short-circuited) request=r-0a3b9c1d
```

mika: customer is blocked — their production path depends on ranking. they explicitly asked for a fix or a rollback.

lenore: immediate workaround: tell them to pass the canonical model id "redwood/rerank-2026-quant" in the "model" field. that should bypass alias resolution.

support-bot: canned response suggested:
"Hi — apologies. As a temporary workaround, please set `model` to `redwood/rerank-2026-quant`. We are investigating an alias migration edge-case that can return an empty score vector."

eng-oncall: action items:
- alex: open a PR to make alias-resolve failures return 4xx and stop silent fallback (high priority)
- eng-infra: roll back alias-migration job for affected namespaces or patch mapping (ASAP)
- support: send workaround to customer and ask for any additional request-ids

alex: will open PR now. linking draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank/pull/837

lenore: thanks. ping me when PR is merged and we have a rollout window so we can notify the customer. :thumbsup:
